run_fused_moe: run the fused MoE layer with hidden states, expert weights, and top-k gating output
create_fused_experts_impl: create a fused MoE computation pipeline with expert weights, top-k ids, and activation function
test_fused_experts: test the fused MoE expert computation with optional quantization and gating parameters
refactor_inplace_fused_experts: refactor the inplace fused MoE expert kernel to mutate hidden states in-place
summarize_fused_moe_kernel_sequence: summarize the MoE kernel sequence with gate, activation, down-projection, and token combination steps
